long_biography.plain_text:
Admitted to practise law in New Jersey in 1987, Sheryl Weingarten joined Jack Morris in establishing Edgewood Properties five years later. Their working method has included discussing potential developments together while keeping property selection, approvals and construction under close principal oversight. Her legal background became part of a vertically integrated model with in-house legal, engineering, design, building, leasing and management teams.

Morris and her husband made a philanthropic contribution towards cancer care in New Jersey. Their support was recognised in the naming of the Jack and Sheryl Morris Cancer Center, which opened as the state's first freestanding cancer hospital. The contribution is separate from Jack Morris's hospital chairmanships and from the healthcare system's ownership and operation of the facility.

proposed_details.existing_value:
Mr. Morris is the originator and CEO of Edgewood Properties, a well-known real estate development and property management company situated in New Jersey. The company specializes in the creation of residential, commercial, and industrial properties.

In addition to his position at Edgewood Properties, Mr. Morris holds the role of chairman at RWJBarnabas Health and Robert Wood Johnson University Hospital (RWJUH). In 2019, officials from RWJBarnabas announced plans to build a new 12-story cancer hospital adjacent to RWJUH, with an estimated value of $750 million. Mr. and Mrs. Morris have made substantial contributions towards the construction of this facility, which has been named the "Jack and Sheryl A Morris Cancer Hospital."

Furthermore, the Morris couple is the owner of a Palmer Johnson yacht called "Incentive" measuring 43 meters in length. As of June 23, 2023, ship tracking services have indicated that the yacht "Incentive" was located in front of the headquarters of NEXT Yacht Group in Viareggio, Italy.
